description: Defines the class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Cross' which represents a cross-shaped data marker for a graph rendering utility, including methods for drawing the marker on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Cross
classes.description: A class for rendering a cross-shaped marker on a graph canvas, extending the Image_Graph_Marker base class.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws a cross-shaped marker at specified (x, y) coordinates on the canvas, with optional data values.
